name: Daisy Completion Defect Laws
statement: $\delta_D$ vanishes exactly on daisy cubes, is nonincreasing under nonempty pc-minors, and satisfies $|C\times E|+\delta_D(C\times E)=(|C|+\delta_D(C))(|E|+\delta_D(E))$ on disjoint coordinates.
proof: Projection and conditioning map missing points of a rooted completion injectively into missing points before the operation. Rooted completion commutes with Cartesian products, and the two positive completion sizes minimize independently.
